title: Everyday Phrases — A Dance Class
title_quote: Hi, I want a dance class.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💃 實用舞蹈課必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — A Dance Class
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的舞蹈課情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從選舞種辦卡、到店熱身數拍，到學八步組合、回家練功，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical A Dance Class phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), from picking a style and buying a class card, to warm-up counts, the eight-step combo and home practice. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I want a dance class.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我們有很多舞種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which style is easiest for me?
dialogue.zh: 哪種舞我學起來最容易？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try salsa, it is quite slow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never danced a day in my life.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ˈdænst ə deɪ ɪn maɪ laɪf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a partner first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們這裡輪換舞伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she speak slowly in class?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很慢，而且每個動作都示範。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the next salsa class?
dialogue.zh: 下一堂薩爾薩課是什麼時候？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I just try one class?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the first trial is free.
dialogue.zh: 當然，第一堂體驗課免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much after the free trial?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to buy a card?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu baɪ ə kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, pay per class is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But a card is cheaper, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten classes cost one fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stays good for six months.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my friend use my card?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友可以用我的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss a lesson?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I book a spot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在線上用我們簡單的預約應用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I book by phone instead?
dialogue.zh: 我可以改用電話預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, my number is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I book the room too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I reserve two hours daily?
dialogue.zh: 我每天可以訂兩小時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but book one day ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I wear for class?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are jeans okay to dance in?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, soft shorts work just fine.
dialogue.zh: 可以，軟一點的短褲就很合適。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 跳華爾茲要穿高跟鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a bench sits by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə bɛntʃ sɪts baɪ ðə dɔr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I take off my bracelet?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they stop me at five?
dialogue.zh: 過五分鐘就不讓我進嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We close the door after ten.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need water with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a bottle, we refill it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I fill my bottle?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is music loud in that room?
dialogue.zh: 那間教室音樂很大聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這裡不用耳機，只有音響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one whole wall is glass.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is wooden and dry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 成年人真的能學會跳舞嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most of our students are adults.
dialogue.zh: 我們大部分學員都是成年人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I look silly in there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 從不會，那是我們的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring her, both trials are free.
dialogue.zh: 帶她來吧，兩堂體驗都免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay today or Tuesday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay when you book the card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I cancel my booking free?
dialogue.zh: 我可以免費取消預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if it is two days early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪf ɪt ɪz tu deɪz ˈɜrli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it, ten minutes early!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this key open locker nine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, yours is by the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I leave my jacket here?
dialogue.zh: 我的外套可以放這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 櫃子放得下包包和外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I change my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small room on your left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很完美，地板都還是白的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There she is, waving at us.
dialogue.zh: 她來了，正在跟我們揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, this is my first week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you danced here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you remember your first day?
dialogue.zh: 你還記得自己第一天嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I stand next to him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, half are new like you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, or your legs will hurt.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I roll my neck?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not even close to my toes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is totally normal, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we stretch the ankles too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She counts one two three four.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the beat fast or slow?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All I hear is one beat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 併腳就是雙腳靠在一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then she taps the floor twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, I lost the count.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it okay to watch first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 老師，為什麼不能一直看？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I will try feeling it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is practice with the same songs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跳舞就是會讓人人如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight? That sounds like a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step one, slide to the right.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then bring the left foot in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step three is a small kick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick a spot and look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ə spɑt ænd lʊk æt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lean a bit, do not fall.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 原位就是雙腳再度併好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we mirror the whole thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mirror? Which way is left now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the mirror, left is right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the steps, then feel them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we redo steps four to six?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi riˈdu stɛps fɔr tu sɪks?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能重來四到六步嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step seven keeps slipping past me.
dialogue.zh: 第七步老是從我腳邊溜走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們今天上課前就見過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You dance much better than me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am still new, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will, you do the same.
dialogue.zh: 我會的，你也一樣提醒我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, was my turn too small?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low hands? I did not notice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start the move on the drum.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us run it once more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Being in sync feels so good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mirror shows my back foot.
dialogue.zh: 鏡子裡看得到我的後腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is fine, room is tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 該是我喝水休息的時間了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why do we dance in pairs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 同伴能抓到你看不見的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I found my own mistake.
dialogue.zh: 今天我發現了自己的一個錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I start with the wrong foot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I feel ready for music.
dialogue.zh: 現在我覺得可以合音樂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, I forgot step six.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was fun, one more time?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The teacher wants to film us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, I look strange there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 影片能幫我們修正動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me text it after class.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It climbs when I get nervous.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine was stiff the whole time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk in circles, shake it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out as you hold it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我就算站著不動都在流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did I do fine back there?
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛表現得還可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 週二，同一時間，二號教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sign up right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put your name on the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊt jʊr neɪm ɑn ðə lɪst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還剩三個位置，先搶一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay there or here?
dialogue.zh: 我是在那邊還是在這裡付？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my class card?
dialogue.zh: 我可以用我的課程卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it has ten classes.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，裡面有十堂課。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A full ten? Perfect for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 趁還沒用光再多訂幾堂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next week we add new steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 還要加新動作？聽起來好難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At home I will practice turns.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 鄰居可能會聽到那首歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use small speakers, keep it low.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I mirror the whole eight?
dialogue.zh: 我要把八拍兩個方向都練嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both sides, ten times each.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The shop here sells practice clothes.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的店面也賣練功服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us look, I need shorts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這件緊身長褲摸起來很軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, raise your arms, test it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two, you sweat a lot.
dialogue.zh: 買兩件吧，你會流很多汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They grip, that keeps you safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Home at last, what a night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這種痠代表真的有練到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wear the softest shoes you own.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me rub cream on my calves.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi rʌb krim ɑn maɪ kælvz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gently, then lift your feet up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better? That helps the blood flow.
dialogue.zh: 好點了嗎？這樣幫助血液循環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You worked like a real student.
dialogue.zh: 你練得就像個認真學員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A real student still forgets steps.
dialogue.zh: 認真的學員也會忘記動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Compare one hour ago to now.
dialogue.zh: 把一小時前和現在比一比。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An hour ago I froze completely.
dialogue.zh: 一小時前我還整個僵住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We danced it, both of us.
dialogue.zh: 是我們一起跳的，我們兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你該這樣想，現在好好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just one, then rest those feet.
dialogue.zh: 只看一次，然後讓腳休息。
